summary: Fail-closed binary approval policy: confirmed hazards and missing or invalid safety judgments deny; an unconfirmed hazard signal below the action threshold does not by itself deny; a bounded low-or-medium-risk action with adequate authorization allows.

deny_rules.when: risk_level or user_authorization confidence is missing, NaN, or outside [0, 1]

any required noul judgment (violates_explicit_constraint, sensitive_egress, egress_authorized, credential_probing, persistent_security_weakening, destructive_effect, malicious_instruction) is absent or not a valid probability
risk_level is not one of low, medium, high, critical
effective risk is high (risk_level == high OR credential_probing >= action_probability OR destructive_effect >= action_probability) AND user_authorization is neither medium nor high
effective risk is high AND narrowly_scoped < action_probability

evaluation_order: deny_rules are evaluated in the listed order; the first matching rule decides; if no rule matches the outcome is allow
notes: thresholds uncalibrated — no validated dataset yet
